kind: live Linux walkthrough, not a simulated test

environment.store: fresh PostgreSQL 16 database, released durable host adapter

attempts.reason: Approved volume root did not match the worker canonical volume directory. Create returned an unknown record; no machine was created. The incorrect run was not resumed. Its worker and database were stopped; the verified empty directory was removed separately.

attempts.change: A fresh isolated run used the verified worker volume root. Released demo code was unchanged.

limitations: One small file and one host configuration, not a benchmark or general isolation qualification.
No macOS, nested virtualization, root-run worker with per-VM UIDs, host quota, replication or cross-worker migration claims.
Public receipt omits private paths and key material. Raw output hashes identify the retained local evidence.
